thread:
sarah-customer: fyi — AcmeApp reached out, their promo trial (promo_2026Q1) shows applied but the credits ended up on an old restored tenant after an SSO merge. Main org shows zero balance. Can someone take a look?

maria-cs: thanks, can you drop the customer org id + the tenant id that has the credit? also their primary workspace id if you have it.

sarah-customer: Org: org-98765, primary workspace: ws-2222, credited tenant: tenant-arch-003 (this tenant was restored from archive during the customer's Okta -> SAML migration last week). Promo code: promo_2026Q1.

billing-bot: Auto-note: promo_2026Q1 applied to tenant-arch-003, amount: $150 free credits. Transaction id: tx-55123.

jordan-ops: likely hit from SSO merge / restore flow where the old archived tenant was brought back and kept an old service account mapping. Quick checks: did they have duplicate identities in SSO that mapped to a separate org id?

acme-app-support: yes — our SSO created a new primary so we made a new org during onboarding, then restored the old org to pull historical data. We never expected credits to attach to the restored org.

kyle-eng: can you paste the event log for the promo application? specifically the allocation path in the ledger. If you don't have it, run SQL:

```
SELECT id, tenant_id, org_id, promo, amount, created_at
FROM promo_allocations
WHERE promo = 'promo_2026Q1'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

That will show where the system wrote the row.

sarah-customer: pasted output: `tx-55123 | tenant-arch-003 | org-arch-001 | promo_2026Q1 | 150 | 2026-02-11T16:22:10Z` — org-arch-001 is the restored org.

maria-cs: ok, we need to move the allocation to org-98765/ws-2222. Ops, can you run the internal transfer script? Steps: 1) mark allocation as pending-transfer 2) create allocation under target org 3) adjust balances 4) audit log. Use dry-run first.

jordan-ops: running dry-run now: `./tools/credit-transfer --tx tx-55123 --target-org org-98765 --target-ws ws-2222 --dry-run`

jordan-ops: dry-run looks good — shows change delta of +150 to ws-2222 and -150 from tenant-arch-003. Going to attempt actual run in 5m.

kyle-eng: heads up: if the target org has a conflicting allocation record we might get a 409. If that happens use the `--force` flag but check audit logs first.

jordan-ops: executing: `./tools/credit-transfer --tx tx-55123 --target-org org-98765 --target-ws ws-2222`

jordan-ops: got 409 conflict on create: "allocation already exists for promo_2026Q1 on org-98765". investigating.

sarah-customer: weird — the customer page shows zero balance for org-98765.

kyle-eng: that 409 means there is likely a stale placeholder row or partial rollback from earlier retry. Query for any promo rows for the target org:

```
SELECT * FROM promo_allocations WHERE org_id = 'org-98765' AND promo = 'promo_2026Q1';
```

This should tell us if a zero-amount placeholder exists.

jordan-ops: found row: `id placeholder-789 | org-98765 | tenant-null | promo_2026Q1 | 0 | 2026-02-11T16:22:12Z` — that explains 409. looks like a preflight created a placeholder then failed to populate amount.

maria-cs: OK plan: 1) backfill the placeholder with the 150 and set tenant ref to ws-2222 2) mark tx-55123 as migrated 3) create audit entry citing SSO-restore remap. Kyle, can you confirm no other systems will read that placeholder and trigger double-charge?

kyle-eng: confirmed — placeholder is not used for billing consumption, only allocation. Backfill safe. Use: `./tools/credit-transfer --tx tx-55123 --target-org org-98765 --target-ws ws-2222 --repair-placeholder placeholder-789`

jordan-ops: running repair now...

jordan-ops: success — placeholder updated to amount 150, tenant set to ws-2222, tx marked migrated, audit log created. Customer balance now shows +150 in org-98765.

sarah-customer: relaying to customer — they confirmed balance reflected correctly in dashboard. Thanks team! :tada:

maria-cs: leaving a ticket note with root cause: SSO restore left an archived org with stale service-account mapping; promo allocation API used tenant mapping and picked restored org. Recommendation: add a check in promo allocation flow to prefer active primary org mapping when multiple identities exist. Filing follow-up ticket in product.

kyle-eng: created PR with a guard clause and unit test to prefer active primary mapping. will link once merged. :eyes:

jordan-ops: closing this thread after follow-up tasks. :thumbsup:
